truth_boundary.statement: This is a content-read and static-source audit. It is not a runtime, security, legal, production-readiness, qualification or admission claim.

content_evidence: src/host.ts defines HostContext, deny-by-default capability checks, workspace matching, BlockRegistry and ordered block lifecycle.
src/sdk/core.ts defines an experimental SessionAdapter, namespace ownership checks, fail-closed session evaluation and ordered cleanup/revoke.
docs/BLOCK-SDK-CANDIDATE.md explicitly says namespace isolation is descriptive rather than infrastructure enforcement and the candidate is not a production auth broker.
current_base_content_findings.reuse_decision: Extend through a new platform namespace; do not replace or edit the held host/SDK files in this lane.

content_evidence: src/host.ts fixtureIdentity returns a literal fixture token and fixtureBindings has no durable identity store.
src/knowledge.ts fetches and validates the existing AFFiNE signed-context bridge, including client, expiry, identity and workspace checks.
README.md declares production authentication and long-lived services deliberate non-goals at the baseline commit.
current_base_content_findings.gap: No durable Base user, tenant, workspace, membership, provider identity or session record exists in this repository.

content_evidence: RuntimeBindings and RuntimeNamespace can name Postgres schemas, Redis namespaces and object namespaces.
There is no database client or ORM dependency, no migrations directory and no RLS policy in the baseline tree.
current_base_content_findings.gap: Actionist-host durable records, migration authority, database roles, tenant transaction context and RLS remain unimplemented.

content_evidence: No package dependency, source module or migration implements Stripe, provider events, subscriptions or entitlements.

The inspected local finance research identifies an earlier SISOCRM Stripe/RevenueCat payment-event and quota update implementation, but its cited source checkout is not present at the recorded path in this environment.
current_base_content_findings.gap: Provider facts must not become authority directly; Base needs idempotent provider-event storage and Base-owned entitlement grants.

content_evidence: The current Base can pass objectNamespace metadata to a block but owns no upload, object-key, signing, retention or deletion contract.
current_base_content_findings.gap: S3-compatible access remains an adapter and deployment concern.

content_evidence: No mail transport, template, outbox, delivery-event or local catcher dependency appears in package or source.
current_base_content_findings.gap: Only a future SMTP/provider port is justified; deliverability is unproven.

content_evidence: No queue, worker, scheduler or job persistence dependency appears in package or source.
current_base_content_findings.gap: The bounded slice may define no worker runtime; durable jobs remain behind a future port.

content_evidence: No flag evaluator, provider SDK or flag storage exists in the baseline tree.
current_base_content_findings.gap: Initial flags should remain Base-owned data with a replaceable evaluation seam rather than a new service dependency.

content_evidence: src/knowledge.ts reads four Vite environment variables for the local AFFiNE bridge; no central typed config or secret-reference registry exists.
current_base_content_findings.gap: Secret values must remain external references; this slice must not introduce credentials or a secret service.

content_evidence: Host event envelopes carry actor and correlation fields, but no append-only durable audit store exists.
current_base_content_findings.gap: The first migration needs a Base-owned append-only tenant-scoped audit record without claiming an operational retention regime.

content_evidence: Host and SDK health types fail closed and the AFFiNE adapter performs semantic user/workspace read-back; no telemetry SDK or collector is configured.
current_base_content_findings.gap: OpenTelemetry-compatible attributes and provider selection remain contractual, not instrumented.

content_evidence: README.md declares deployment and long-lived services out of scope; no container, deploy, backup, WAL or restore source exists in the baseline tree.
current_base_content_findings.gap: This packet authorizes contracts only; no deploy target, backup set or restore point may be claimed.

prior_selected_machinery.source: P09 data-plane survey and decision ledger
prior_selected_machinery.content_fact: The survey selected PostgreSQL for Actionist-owned state, Drizzle as the typed query/schema candidate, pg-boss for Postgres-backed jobs and SeaweedFS as the maintained permissive S3-compatible candidate; it explicitly found no mature TypeScript multi-tenancy/RLS framework and assigned tenant isolation to Actionist.
prior_selected_machinery.limits: No dependency tree, SBOM, runtime, tenant isolation or legal review was performed.

prior_selected_machinery.content_fact: Identity and authorization are well supplied; settings schemas are not. Better Auth is the TypeScript library candidate, while the host must own its canonical tenant/workspace model and settings provenance.
prior_selected_machinery.limits: Several P10 maintenance judgments were originally unverified; Better Auth maintenance is instead grounded in the separate P03 census.

prior_selected_machinery.content_fact: OpenTelemetry Collector and Prometheus were observed active under Apache-2.0; Kamal was observed active under MIT but its rollback restores images rather than current secrets or accessories.
prior_selected_machinery.limits: No collector, backend, deployment or rollback was executed.

prior_selected_machinery.content_fact: The research records a real Stripe/RevenueCat subscription integration, idempotent provider-event migration and quota/entitlement update precedent.
prior_selected_machinery.limits: The cited SISOCRM source checkout was absent when probed, so this lane does not elevate the summary to direct source verification.
